Troubleshooting

Start with the message shown in VIKI Agent. Then:

  1. Open Diagnostics for provider and storage readiness.
  2. Open Data locations if you need the active app-data path.

If the window cannot open, a startup message may name the log. The log is logs/viki-agent.log under the app-data folder. It records warnings and errors; an empty file is possible after a healthy launch.

What you seeWhat to do
Claude Code is not ready to start a sessionOpen Settings → Providers. A missing CLI shows the install command for your OS; install it, then restart VIKI Agent so it is found. Still signed out? Send a message and use the chat's Sign in button, or run claude and use its login flow yourself. For Claude Code's own diagnostics, run claude doctor in a terminal. With Let Claude Code use its other sign-in methods turned off, a billing-related readiness warning means Claude Code is signed in to, or set up to bill, an account other than your Claude subscription: sign in with your Claude subscription, remove the setting that Settings → Providers lists, or turn that switch back on in Settings › Chat. After any of the three, restart VIKI Agent. To sign in, run claude auth login in a terminal; the billing message has no Sign in button. A listed setting also blocks chats on a model connection; a sign-in to another account alone does not.
claude: update neededClaude Code is older than the range VIKI Agent has tested. Run claude update, or upgrade it with WinGet, Homebrew or your Linux package manager, then select Check Claude Code in Settings → Providers.
Profile launch refused (…_unconfirmed) in a profile or Bot chatClaude Code did not confirm the profile's plan mode, model or app MCP servers when it started, so nothing was sent. Edit the profile in Agents and start again.
You can run at most 30 sessions at the same time. Close one, or raise the limit in Settings › Chat, then send again.Your limit shows in place of 30. Close a chat that is running Claude Code, or raise Sessions running at once in Settings › Chat (1 to 999). Closing its tab does not erase its transcript.
Disconnected. Reconnecting…Wait for the window to reconnect. Check Drafts and send history before resending a turn whose delivery is uncertain.
This window belongs to a previous launchClose that window and open VIKI Agent again. The conversation records remain with Claude Code.
A reply is still runningSelect Stop or press Esc. A hook, tool or connector can hold a turn open without a turn deadline. If Claude Code's process must be ended, inspect the resulting status before retrying.
A note save reports a conflictReopen the current note and compare it with your draft. Save only after reviewing the newer version; the app did not replace it.
Save says the drive does not support saving notesThe drive is not NTFS (Windows), APFS (macOS) or ext4, XFS, Btrfs or tmpfs (Linux), such as a network or exFAT drive. The vault stays read-only there; browse and search still work, or ask Claude Code to make a change under its own permissions.
A routine says Missed, unknown or blockedOpen that routine's run history and its chat, when present. A missed schedule is not run later automatically; an unknown result needs inspection before a manual retry.
A routine says Skipped (No card was waiting on Kanban)The routine is set to Only when a card is waiting. It found no note directly in its vault's kanban/ folder with status: todo in lowercase and an owner/<seat> tag naming its Seat. Check the card's spelling: status: todo in lowercase, and the tag exactly owner/<seat> with no # and no capitals. Also check that the note is directly in kanban/, not in a subfolder or a Kanban/ folder. A card VIKI Agent cannot read does not cause Skipped: the time then runs as usual. Test run and Run now run without checking. See Bots.
A routine says Skipped (No note changed in its folder)The routine is set to Only when a note changed. It found no note at any depth in its folder with a file time after the start of its last run at this version that succeeded or stopped for your decision. Check the folder's spelling: a folder with no notes, or a misspelled one, never counts as changed. A note moved or synced in can keep an older file time; edit it or use Run now. When VIKI Agent cannot list the whole vault, the time runs as usual. See Bots.
A routine says Stopped for your decisionThe routine is set to Stop at a draft, and Claude asked for a permission or a plan. Open the run's session for the draft and its report, and ask it to continue there once you decide. For later runs to wait for your OK instead, set When a confirmation is needed to Wait until the time limit.
Kanban shows no cardsKanban, routines and VIKI read only notes directly in kanban/ (lowercase). Move the cards there, or ask a chat in that vault to, then update your Never send folder rules to name kanban/. Bookmarks to moved cards show as missing.
A Kanban card shows under Couldn't readKanban could not read the card, and the card names the reason. When the reason is the front matter, keep it as simple as /kanban and the card template write it: the title in the card's # heading with no title: line, and tags: on one line. When the card says Kanban tries again, it does so on its own, at first after 1 second and then at most 30 seconds apart. See Bots.
VIKI does not start a Bot for a todo cardA Report in VIKI's launcher names why it held a start back: today's limit, the Pause automatic starts at Claude plan usage setting, quiet hours, a routine changed since its test, or two routines for one seat. VIKI starts a Bot itself only while Start Bots' work is Allowed; Ask first, the default, offers Start instead. The seat needs exactly one enabled routine set to Only when a card is waiting, tested at its current version. The vault's policy must be Ordinary. VIKI also starts none, without a Report, while Proactive VIKI is off or paused, while another routine run is going, or while Pause all holds your routines. A card written during a routine run or a chat VIKI started gets Start instead, unless Let seats hand work to each other is on. See Start Bots' work.
What VIKI may do reads HoldingPause automatic starts at Claude plan usage is holding the chats, Bot runs and inbox suggestion runs VIKI starts on its own, and the row says until when. Your own starts still work. VIKI also holds them until Claude Code first reports your plan use after VIKI Agent starts, and while your plan limit is reached, at every setting. See Pause automatic starts at Claude plan usage.
Dictation or read-aloud has no voiceCheck Settings → Chat and the operating system's microphone or installed voices. Dictation depends on its local model and engine; read-aloud depends on a browser-reported local voice.

  1. 01When the app cannot open normally

01When the app cannot open normally

A missing browser, occupied port 8765, unavailable data folder or missing built UI can stop startup. Follow the startup message.

  • A browser left open after an earlier crash (macOS and Linux)
    it can block a new launch. Quit that browser, then start VIKI Agent again.
  • A second launch merely opens another window
    the first instance is already running.

Read-only recovery window

A damaged, locked or newer app store opens a read-only recovery window with Diagnostics and the refusal reason, without starting a chat.

Warning

Do not use Reset or delete app.sqlite3 to clear that screen: the database can contain drafts, submissions and preferences that exports do not recreate.

Instead:

  1. Close VIKI Agent.
  2. Copy the entire app-data folder to a separate safe location, including database sidecars and retained backups.
  3. Inspect the reported cause.

An older build may not open data upgraded by a newer one.

  • Rolling back
    if you need to roll back, return to the matching build or a complete cold backup. Changes made after that backup will be absent.
  • Upgrade backups
    each upgrade step also leaves a verified copy of the database as it was, app.sqlite3.v<N>-backup-<id>.sqlite3, in the app-data folder. See Sharing diagnostics and backups for restoring one.

Updating a source checkout

Closing the last window alone can leave a turn running. Before updating a source checkout:

  1. Stop running chats.
  2. Close VIKI Agent, and wait for its process to exit.
    • Windows
      confirm in Task Manager that the VIKI Agent process you launched has exited.
    • macOS
      quit the browser VIKI Agent opened if it remains open.
    • Linux
      wait until the command you started VIKI Agent with, such as uv run viki-agent, returns to the prompt.
  3. Keep a complete cold copy of the app-data folder and any vault backup you depend on.
  4. Follow the install and build steps in Getting started.
  5. Reopen the app and check Diagnostics.

A newer build can upgrade app state, so keep the matching build with a backup intended for rollback.

Sealed values on macOS and Linux

On macOS and Linux, sealed local values depend on the platform keychain and the sealing-key-id record in the app-data folder.

  • Keychain locked or unavailable
    unlock or restore it and restart the app.
  • Data folder moved
    restore its original path before retrying.
  • Key-id file
    keep it with the folder. Deleting it while the keychain is merely locked can strand existing drafts and other sealed values.

Unfinished saves and note operations

When the Vault view's Recovery panel still lists a save or note operation that didn't finish after you restart VIKI Agent:

  1. Copy the vault and the app-data folder before changing either one.
  2. Compare the note at each path involved and any entry in Recovery. An interrupted operation or another program may have changed the note.

Do not delete a hidden temporary file or a backup of the previous version in the vault, and do not overwrite a note to force the operation through. VIKI Agent stops an operation it cannot be sure of so you can decide which version to keep.

Sharing a diagnostics report

For a report you choose to share, use Export diagnostics and inspect the JSON before sending it. Redaction may miss context you consider private.

See Known issues for limits you may run into and Sessions and data before Reset.
